---
title: "Publication Details"
---

<!-- Placeholder alerts for loading and errors -->
<div id="loading" class="alert alert-info">Loading publication data...</div>
<div id="error-message" class="alert alert-danger" style="display: none;"></div>

<!-- The Publication Card (Hidden until data loads) -->
<div id="publication-card" class="card shadow-sm mt-3" style="display: none;">
<div class="card-body">
    
<h2 id="pub-title" class="card-title text-primary mb-3"></h2>
    
<div class="mb-3 text-muted" style="font-size: 1.1rem;">
  <strong>Journal:</strong> <span id="pub-journal"></span> | 
  <strong>Year:</strong> <span id="pub-year"></span> | 
  <strong>City:</strong> <a id="pub-city" href="#" target="_blank"></a></p>
</div>

<p><strong>DOI:</strong> <a id="pub-doi" href="#" target="_blank"></a></p>
    
<hr>
    
<h4 class="mt-4">Abstract</h4>
<p id="pub-abstract" style="line-height: 1.6; text-align: justify;"></p>
    
<hr>
    
<div class="row mt-4">
<div class="col-md-6 mb-2">
  <strong>Detected Ticks:</strong> <span id="pub-ticks" class="badge bg-secondary"></span>
</div>
<div class="col-md-6 mb-2">
  <strong>Notes:</strong> <span id="pub-notes"></span>
</div>
</div>
    
<div class="mt-4 text-end text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">
Record ID: <span id="pub-id"></span>
</div>
    
</div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  function setText(id, text) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = text;
    } else {
      console.warn("Missing HTML element: " + id);
    }
  }


  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  let pubId = params.get('ID') || params.get('id') || window.location.search.substring(1).replace('ID=', '');

  const loadingEl = document.getElementById('loading');
  const errorEl = document.getElementById('error-message');
  const cardEl = document.getElementById('publication-card');

  if (!pubId) {
    if (loadingEl) loadingEl.style.display = 'none';
    if (errorEl) {
      errorEl.textContent = "No publication ID specified in the URL.";
      errorEl.style.display = 'block';
    }
    return;
  }

  Papa.parse("./intermediates/final_dat.csv", {
    download: true,
    header: true,
    skipEmptyLines: true,
    complete: function (results) {
      

      const pub = results.data.find(row => row.ID === pubId);

      if (loadingEl) loadingEl.style.display = 'none';

      if (!pub) {
        if (errorEl) {
          errorEl.textContent = "Publication not found for ID: " + pubId;
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
        }
        return;
      }

      setText('pub-title', pub.ArticleTitle || "Not available");
      setText('pub-journal', pub.Title || "Not available");
      setText('pub-year', pub.year || "Not available");
      setText('pub-city', pub.city || "Not available");
      setText('pub-abstract', pub.AbstractText || "Not available");
      setText('pub-notes', pub.notes || "Not available");
      setText('pub-id', pub.ID);


      const doiLink = document.getElementById('pub-doi');
      if (doiLink) {
        if (pub.DOI && pub.DOI !== "NA") {
          doiLink.textContent = pub.DOI;
          doiLink.href = "https://doi.org/" + pub.DOI;
        } 
      }
      
      const cityLink = document.getElementById('pub-city');
      if (cityLink) {
        if (pub.city && pub.city !== "NA") {
          cityLink.textContent = pub.city;
          cityLink.href = "city.html?" + pub.city;
        } 
      }


      if (cardEl) cardEl.style.display = 'block';
      document.title = pub.ArticleTitle || "Publication Details";
    },
    error: function(err) {
      if (loadingEl) loadingEl.style.display = 'none';
      if (errorEl) {
        errorEl.textContent = "Error loading data file. Check your file path.";
        errorEl.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }
  });
});
</script>
